fields.title: Article / latest-headline record
fields.description: Raw-passthrough dataset envelope. Every record carries _input/_source/_scrapedAt (and _error/_errorDetail on failures). Article-mode records (S1-html, articleBody pulled from HTML div.ag-article-text since ld+json has no articleBody/author/datePublished) carry headline/articleBody-style fields; latest-mode records (S2-html-listing, homepage link scan since the site has no RSS feed or sitemap) carry title/link-style fields.

_input.title: Input
_input.description: The exact input value (URL, or 'latest') that produced this record.

_source.title: Source strategy
_source.description: Which extraction strategy emitted this record (e.g. S1-html, S2-html-listing).

_scrapedAt.title: Scraped at
_scrapedAt.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp when this record was scraped.

_error.title: Error
_error.description: Present only on failed extractions -- the error kind.

_errorDetail.title: Error detail
_errorDetail.description: Free-form diagnostic detail, present only alongside _error.

headline.title: Headline
headline.description: Article headline, from the ld+json NewsArticle block.

description.title: Description
description.description: Short article description/teaser, from the ld+json NewsArticle block.

articleBody.title: Article body
articleBody.description:
Full article text, joined from

/

paragraphs inside div.ag-article-text (excludes p.Caption/p.Source image-caption paragraphs interleaved in the same container).

author.title: Author
author.description: Byline name from the article header's div.author element. Absent (null) on unsigned wire-desk pieces and some opinion columns -- not present in ld+json at all.

category.title: Category
category.description: Section slug parsed from the article URL path (e.g. 'news', 'business', 'sports', 'opinion', 'article').

datePublished.title: Date published
datePublished.description: ISO 8601 publish timestamp derived from the HTML createdTimeRaw field, assuming Trinidad & Tobago's fixed UTC-4 offset (AST, no DST observed). Not present in ld+json at all -- synthesized field, see CRAWLING_METHOD.md.

dateModified.title: Date modified
dateModified.description: Last-modified timestamp string exactly as emitted by ld+json (RFC-822-style, e.g. 'Tue, 25 Aug 2026 07:44:17 -0400') -- passed through as-is, not reformatted.

createdTimeRaw.title: Created time (raw)
createdTimeRaw.description: Raw YYYYMMDDHHMMSS string from HTML span.textelement-createdtime -- the source value datePublished is derived from.

publishDateRaw.title: Publish date (raw)
publishDateRaw.description: Raw YYYYMMDD day-precision string from HTML span.textelement-publishing.date -- secondary/redundant to datePublished.

image.title: Image
image.description: Lead image object from ld+json (article mode, {url, width, height, caption}) or the thumbnail URL scraped from the homepage listing (latest mode).

isAccessibleForFree.title: Accessible for free
isAccessibleForFree.description: Upstream paywall metering flag from ld+json. Emitted upstream as the string "true"/"false", not a boolean -- passed through as-is.

title.title: Title
title.description: Headline text of a latest-mode homepage listing item (longest anchor text found for the link).

link.title: Link
link.description: Article URL, normalized to an absolute https:// URL.

articleId.title: Article ID
articleId.description: Numeric CMS content ID parsed out of the article URL (the '6.2.<id>.<hash>' path segment). Latest mode sorts by this descending as a best-effort recency proxy -- the site has no date in its URLs and no feed/sitemap to source a real timestamp from without visiting each article.

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: Key columns across both article and latest-headline records.
